scope: What the iOS Simulator helper (oasim serve, coax/lib/agent/device/sim-host.coax) and its clients say over its Unix socket (~/.openagents/sim/simhost.sock, mode 0600): one JSON object a line each way. The clients are OpenAgents Desktop's pane (client app, the person) and oasim's verbs (client oasim: an agent's shell; later oasim mcp). docs/desktop/ios-simulator-spec.md section 7.4; GitHub #13811.
captured: 2026-11-20, by coder/tui/simhost-check.coax (--wire-log) against a helper built from this tree, on a throwaway iPhone 17 (iOS 26.5, Xcode 26.6) the check created and deleted. Every line is what a program wrote; the check's two connections (app and agent) are kept in the order each end wrote or read them.
framing: A line ends with one line feed. Requests carry an id the reply echoes (id 0: no reply is wanted; a line the helper can't read gets an id-0 bad_args reply); events carry event and no id, and may carry op (the op they are about). Strings are escaped as coax/lib/json/json.coax jo_str writes them. A number is written bare when whole, else with up to four decimals, never with an exponent. Members are written in the codec's order (sim-wire.coax SW_F_*); the reader takes them in any order but refuses a member it does not know or one given twice.

ops.name: hello
ops.note: the first line of every connection: client (app, oasim or mcp), version, and for an agent its chat, engine and working folder

ops.name: subscribe
ops.note: the app's connection hears events (ask, agent, state, revoked; in Phase 1 surface)

ops.name: list
ops.note: the iOS devices simctl lists, each with booted_by_us

ops.name: boot
ops.note: simctl boot then bootstatus -b; the reply carries udid, points and scale

ops.name: screenshot
ops.note: from the device's framebuffer (SimulatorKit, display frames) or simctl io screenshot and sips (display stills), at scale x points; the reply carries path, points, bytes and the framebuffer's gen. A request that names the gen it has gets a reply with that gen and no path when the screen is unchanged

ops.name: set_appearance
ops.note: simctl ui appearance light|dark

ops.name: deny
ops.note: the person: Don't allow (parked requests end denied)

ops.name: grant
ops.note: the person: allow a chat on a device, scope chat or once

ops.name: appearance
ops.note: the device's appearance

ops.name: open_url
ops.note: simctl openurl

ops.name: launch
ops.note: install (an .app under the chat's folder or our DerivedData), then simctl launch --terminate-running-process

ops.name: shutdown
ops.note: simctl shutdown; an agent may shut down only a device an agent booted

ops.name: button
ops.note: a hardware button (HOME, LOCK, SIDE_BUTTON, SIRI, APPLE_PAY) pressed through SimulatorKit, held duration s (0.1 by default)

ops.name: tap
ops.note: a finger down and up at x, y (device points); duration over 0.5 s is a long press

ops.name: swipe
ops.note: an eased path from x, y to x2, y2 over duration s (0.3 by default), a sample a frame

ops.name: touch_path
ops.note: one finger along points [{x, y, dt_ms}] (at most 2,000 samples, 30 s)

ops.name: press_key
ops.note: a named key count times (1 to 20)

ops.name: text
ops.note: typed key by key (US keyboard ASCII, tabs and newlines); other text goes through the device pasteboard and a Command-V; at most 4,096 bytes, never a known secret

ops.name: touch2_path
ops.note: two fingers along points2 (pinch, rotate), through SimulatorKit's two-finger Indigo touches

ops.name: rotate
ops.note: turns the device a quarter turn, direction left or right (a GSEvent to the device's purple port)

ops.name: set_keyboard
ops.note: shows or hides the software keyboard, state show or hide (the Simulator preference the device reads)

ops.name: describe
ops.note: the frontmost app's accessibility tree through AccessibilityPlatformTranslation, as a text outline in lines: Role "label" = value (x, y, w, h) in device points, two spaces a level (at most 600 elements)

ops.name: logs
ops.note: the device's unified log for the last since seconds (1 to 600, 60 by default), narrowed to bundle's subsystem and process when given; the tail in lines

ops.name: record_start
ops.note: simctl io recordVideo of the device into out (an absolute .mp4 or .mov); one recording a device, ten minutes at most

ops.name: record_stop
ops.note: ends the device's recording (SIGINT); the reply carries the file's path

ops.name: touch
ops.note: the person's finger from the pane: phase down, move or up, pointer, x, y; id 0, no reply. A down interrupts an agent's gesture and holds agent input 1.5 s

ops.name: revoke
ops.note: the person: Stop (the chat's grants end; its clients hear revoked)

ops.name: quit
ops.note: the helper exits after its reply

events.name: state
events.note: a device's state changed (booting, booted, shutting_down, shutdown)

events.name: ask
events.note: an agent's op is parked until the person answers in the app (two minutes)

events.name: agent
events.note: an agent's control op ran, for the badge and the transcript

runs.name: simhost-check
runs.what: hello as the app and as an agent; list; boot; screenshots; a parked ask refused, then a chat grant; set_appearance and appearance; open_url; launch refused outside the chat's folders; an agent's shutdown of the person's device refused; Phase 1 input: HOME, launch Settings, a tap that opens General, a tap off the screen refused, a swipe that scrolls, touch_path, press_key, text, touch2_path (two fingers), the person's touch interrupting an agent's swipe and holding its next op, Phase 3: describe, logs of Settings, set_keyboard, rotate left and back, record_start and record_stop; an unchanged frame not written again; contested under a dev.sh lock; revoke and a second refusal; the helper killed and started again by oasim; shutdown by the person; quit
